errors.text: No prior evidence is cited to support simultaneous mechanical, corrosion, and oxidation benefits from boron addition.
The boron concentration, base-alloy composition, processing route, and thermal history are unspecified, so the intervention is not reproducible.
Corrosion and oxidation environments and temperatures are not defined, preventing a meaningful test of the claimed resistance.
Retention of low density is asserted but density is neither predicted quantitatively nor included among the experimental measurements.
The proposed mechanism does not establish how boron-rich phases would form protective barriers; such phases could instead create galvanic heterogeneity or embrittlement.
